RagShortTexts: Barcelona's Drassanes shipyards and Consolat de Mar maritime courts projected Catalan sea.

Variants.Content: Barcelona stood as the commercial maritime engine of the Crown of Aragon. Its Drassanes shipyards constructed premier naval war-galleys, while the Consolat de Mar tribunal codified pioneering maritime trade jurisprudence accepted across Mediterranean ports.
Catalan merchants exported fine woolens, saffron, and weapons, establishing profitable trading outposts in Sicily and Alexandria.
